operations.title: The norm detects invariant boundary defects away from degree torsion
operations.statement: If quotient pushforward S and fiber trace T satisfy ST=d id and multiplication by d is injective on the target, then S is injective on im T. Thus a defect with image in im T cannot be hidden by the quotient.

operations.title: Degree-prime collapse hides an invariant boundary defect
operations.procedure: For C2->1 over F2, take T(1)=(1,1) and S(x,y)=x+y.
operations.outcome: ST=0 and the nonzero invariant trace vector lies in ker S.
operations.falsifier: This falsifies norm-based defect detection at primes dividing the fiber degree.
